scope.surface: KAD public Community, Programs, Events, Volunteer, Stories, History, Impact, Credits, and Support page families
scope.actor: A visitor deciding what is available, what is verified, and what to do next
scope.task: Find current community information without mistaking preview records for current KAD facts
scope.primary_action: Inspect the relevant record or confirm the latest state through the page-specific action
scope.consequence: The visitor reaches a relevant detail or Discord confirmation path with the publication state still visible
scope.token_authority: src/styles/global.css KAD custom properties and page-family selectors

scenarios.state: production fixtures disabled with empty, pending, and not-published states

units.role: State the route job, publication boundary, and small record summary
Expose schedule, workflow, story, metric, or governance information in a route-specific structure
Disclose fictional data once without repeating prototype labels inside every record
Keep the route title, explanation, and useful summary ahead of the detailed content
Keep a truthful next action reachable near the first mobile viewport where the route has one
Reflow each page family to a single readable column without horizontal overflow
Replace sample records with explicit empty, pending, or not-published states

evidence.note: Community shows a compact orientation, qualified three-value pulse, five-record evidence ledger, dated activity, opt-in people, and source links in semantic order.
The same Community hierarchy reflows at 390x844 without horizontal overflow or hidden actions.
Schedule-first event list with one compact preview disclosure.
Mobile schedule header and action fit without horizontal overflow.
Cycle and work structure replace a generic volunteer hero.
Cycle summary and first process step remain readable on mobile.
Story record exposes date, summary, source label, and read action.
Story index reflows to one column.
Metrics are paired with period, method, source, and update date.
Metric ledger is readable without two-dimensional scrolling.
Governance and funding readiness precede support solicitation.
Funding status and governance requirements lead on mobile.
13 tests passed, including Community fixture qualification, compact notice, lifecycle, privacy, locale, provenance, and overflow checks.
80 tests passed, including exact Community content order, qualified production counts, route hierarchy, empty states, mobile focus, reduced motion, responsive checks, and screenshot artifacts.

parity.note: All reviewed wide routes use task-specific structures and one compact preview boundary.
All reviewed narrow routes preserve content order, action clarity, and viewport containment.
Fixtures stay out of production and incomplete information uses explicit readiness states.

verification.method: Inspect final-size screenshots and run the staging Playwright contract.
verification.expected: Route purpose, useful information, and actions appear before secondary explanation; preview copy is not repeated per card.
verification.result: Observed in six 1440x900 renders; staging Playwright passed 13 of 13 tests.

verification.method: Inspect 390x844 renders and execute mobile overflow, action, locale, and reduced-motion checks.
verification.expected: The same task and truth state remain understandable without horizontal scrolling or a large decorative hero.
verification.result: Observed in six mobile renders; all responsive checks passed.

verification.method: Build with PUBLIC_STAGING_FIXTURES unset and run production route tests.
verification.expected: No sample identities or records appear; empty and not-published states remain explicit and actionable.
